fact: ANATS launched its integrated population and secure documents system (SIGPTS) on 22 January 2020, enrolling biographic and biometric data in a national register, with biometric identification to detect identity fraud and a unique NNI per person.
title: Tchad: L'Anats lance l'identification biométrique
publisher: Initiative sur le droit à la nationalité en Afrique (source: Ndjamena Hebdo)
